Select compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Source molecule_dictionary, molecule_hierarchy, compound_structures, compound_records, docs, activities, assays, target_dictionary. Join molecule_hierarchy on parent_molregno from parent CHEMBL3182437 to child molregno. Join compound_structures on child molregno. Join compound_records on child molregno. Join activities on record_id. Join assays on assay_id. Join docs on doc_id. Join target_dictionary on tid. Filter parent chembl_id equals CHEMBL3182437. Filter target chembl_id equals CHEMBL3430885. Filter standard_type equals IC50. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
